elements.title: Salient Statistics—United States
elements.content:
|                                  | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023e |
|----------------------------------|------|------|------|------|-------|
| Mine production, crude ore       | 629  | 853  | 879  | 672  | 650   |
| Sold and used, processed crude perlite | 397  | 501  | 491  | 458  | 450   |
| Imports for consumption¹          | 180  | 160  | 170  | 240  | 170   |
| Exports¹                         | 19   | 25   | 27   | 22   | 15    |
| Consumption, apparent²           | 560  | 640  | 630  | 680  | 610   |
| Price, average value, free on board mine, dollars per metric ton | 64   | 61   | 64   | 68   | 68    |
| Employment, mine and mill, number | 140  | 140  | 150  | 150  | 150   |
| Net import reliance³ as a percentage of apparent consumption | 29   | 21   | 23   | 32   | 26    |
elements.notes:
¹Includes crude and processed perlite.
²Defined as mine production plus imports minus exports.
³Defined as imports minus exports as a percentage of apparent consumption.
